transcript:
Speaker A (Armaan): Hello Ava, myself Armaan, I mean Armaan only.
Speaker B (Ava): Hi Armaan, nice to meet you.
Speaker A: Same to same.
Speaker B: So what do you do?
Speaker A: Marketing, all types. Digital, offline, emotional. Company takes full benefits of employees.
Speaker B: Why do I get the feeling you're thinking before every sentence?
Speaker A: Because I am. Pehle Hindi mein sochta hoon, phir English mein convert karta hoon, phir grammar check karta hoon. [Because I am. First I think in Hindi, then I convert to English, then I check grammar.]
Speaker B: Seriously?
Speaker A: Haan, English samajh aati hai, movies bhi dekh leta hoon. But jab bolne ka time aata hai, tab dimaag bolta hai: server not found. [Yes, I understand English, I even watch movies. But when it's time to speak, my brain says: server not found.]
Speaker B: Mere saath bhi hua hai aisa, Armaan. [This has happened to me too, Armaan.]
Speaker A: No chance, you are talking in podcast wali English, aur meri English toh customer care ke hold music jaisi hai. [No chance, you are talking in podcast-like English, and my English is like customer care hold music.]
Speaker B: Trust me, a year ago, I used to overthink every sentence. Interviews, meetings, conversations mein main freeze ho jati thi. [Trust me, a year ago, I used to overthink every sentence. I used to freeze in interviews, meetings, and conversations.]
Speaker A: Then what happened?
Speaker B: I actually started using PW Talk app.
Speaker A: Usme kya hai? [What's in it?]
Speaker B: Riva! It's an AI speaking partner. Uske saath aap English kabhi bhi practice kar sakte ho. No judgment, jo hamare liye 24/7 available hai, aur din mein bas 10 to 15 minutes practice karni padegi. [Riva! It's an AI speaking partner. You can practice English with her anytime. No judgment, she is available 24/7 for us, and you only need to practice 10 to 15 minutes a day.]
Speaker A: After using PW Talk, will I sound like you?
Speaker B: No, you will sound like yourself, but even more fluent in English.
Speaker C (Presenter): English speaking seekhna hai toh PW Talk app abhi download karo. [If you want to learn English speaking, download the PW Talk app now.]

summary: An animated mango character struggles to speak English fluently, admitting he translates from Hindi in his head. An avocado character recommends the PW Talk app, highlighting its 24/7 AI speaking partner, Riva, for judgment-free practice. The ad ends with a call to download the app from Google Play.
